title: urn:jmap:* uses an unregistered URN namespace
description: chat-00 Endpoint/MessageAction type URIs (urn:jmap:chat:cap:*) and chat-filenode role urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space use 'jmap' as a URN namespace identifier, which is not registered (RFC 8141); only urn:ietf:params:jmap exists. Decide: move under urn:ietf:params:jmap with registration (like the new JMAP Object URN Types registry), or another form. Touches chat-00, chat-filenode, chat-calendars/tasks (MessageAction types), vtc-00, guides.
